meta.title: Decision Pac-Man: a 0.8B model that beats the halo
meta.description: A 0.8B model, distilled in an afternoon, plays Pac-Man better than a hosted decision service. Watch it, play it, and see what it cost.

hero.title: A hosted decision model vs. a 0.8B we trained ourselves
hero.subtitle: Same maze, same seed, same 30 seconds. Left: Jev. Right: our distilled 0.8B.
hero.note: One 30-second game each. Over 10 full games: Jev {jev_avg} pellets on average, ours {ours_avg}.

play.title: Your turn
play.lead: Same maze, same seed, 30 seconds. Can you beat the models?
play.eyes_hint: No maze. You only get the text the model gets, and the game waits at every junction for your pick.
play.result_title: Time's up. You ate {pellets} pellets: #{rank} of {total}.
play.controls_hint: Arrow keys or WASD. On a phone, swipe on the maze.
play.eyes_waiting: Pac-Man is waiting at the junction. Pick a way.

halo.title: Peel off the halo
halo.lead: Jev is a hosted model trained for decisions. phi4-mini is a plain open model nobody trained for this. Same 30 seconds.
halo.chart_note: Features input, realtime clock, seeds 100-109, 1x speed. The shaded band is where off-the-shelf models and a hand-written rule land.
halo.offline_title: And it runs on a phone
halo.offline_body: A reproduction of the 0.8B runs fully offline on an iPhone, no server involved.

paths.title: Not satisfied? Two paths
paths.lead: When an off-the-shelf model is not good enough, you can make it narrower, or make it think harder.
paths.a_body: Teach a small model one job, using a big model as the teacher.
paths.b_body: Use the big model directly and let it think. Qwen3.8-27B goes from {off} to {on} pellets, if the game waits for it.

recipe.s4_title: It runs offline on an iPhone
recipe.note: Fine-tuning trades size, speed, cost, scenario, and intelligence: on general decision questions it scores 0.53 instead of 0.66.

builder.title: From user to builder
builder.closed_body: If it handles your case, use it. If not, switch vendors.
builder.yours_body: Every dimension can move: size, speed, cost, where it runs, what it is good at.
builder.quote: The question changes from "which service should I pick" to "what should I build".

cta.title: Learn to build this
cta.body: We teach the whole loop: pick a teacher, make data, fine-tune, evaluate, ship.

footer.fineprint: Results are for this one game. 10 games per player. Realtime scores vary between runs.
